_note: PIP's lines and card words by id. Every entry is a placeholder until the event (14 Nov 2026, workspace hard rule 1). ui/game_hud.gd say(id) shows one; an id missing here shows 'TBD at event: <id>' too.
sol1.thin_air: Hear that? Outside, the air is very thin.
sol1.look_around: Look around. This is Gale crater.
sol1.weigh_less: Whoa! Mars pulls you only 0.38 as hard as Earth.
sol1.can_you_lift: Can you lift that cargo bag?
sol1.easy_here: Too heavy on Earth. Here, easy!
sol1.sunlight_power: Sunlight is our power. Mars gets less than half of Earth's.
sol1.every_choice: Power is short this morning. Every choice costs something.
sol1.follow_me: Follow me! Our garden is this way.
choice.sol1_power: Power for one: air or plants?
sol1.keys_ad: Now A and D: walk left and right!
sol1.key_s: S walks you back. Try it!
sol1.look_mouse: Your turn: look all around you!
sol1.hurry: Hurry over to the cargo bags!
sol1.map_close: See the solar farm? Close the map.
sol1.follow_solar: Follow me to the solar farm!
sol1.o2_maker_is: The oxygen maker makes the air we breathe.
sol1.lamps_are: Greenhouse lamps help our plants grow.
nag.sad: Beep... PIP is waiting for you.
task.follow_solar: Follow PIP to the solar farm
sol2.power_low: Check your power meter. It dropped!
sol2.follow_wings: Follow me to the solar wings!
sol2.see_dust: Night wind dropped dust on the wings!
sol2.power_jumped: Look! Power jumped up right away.
sol2.opportunity: In 2018 a dust storm silenced Opportunity.
sol2.reactor: This works day, night and in storms.
sol2.nasa_chose: That's why NASA picked it for Mars crews.
sol3.meet_outside: Morning! Meet me outside. A surprise today!
sol3.robots_planted: Robots planted this lettuce before you came.
sol3.plant: Your turn: plant a seed tray!
sol3.microgreens: Microgreens are ready in 7 to 18 days.
sol3.radish: Radishes take 25 days. Ready before we leave!
sol3.vitamins: Plants give vitamins and smiles, not most food.
sleep.when_ready: Explore! Sleep in HAB 1 when you're ready.
hint.suit_lights: Your helmet lights. Switch them anytime.
sol2.over_there: Look over there! That's our reactor.
sol4.call_earth: Morning! Use the radio to ask Earth something.
sol4.mail_sent: Sent! Now we wait for Earth's answer.
sol4.eleven_min: Radio takes about 11 minutes each way.
sol4.valve: Alarm! The oxygen valve needs a turn. Quick!
sol4.no_wait: Earth is too far to help. Well done!
sol4.reply_soon: Earth's answer is on its way.
sol4.reply_home: Earth answered! Their reply took the trip too.
sol5.morning: Morning! Let's enjoy a quiet day.
sol5.storm: Solar storm coming! Get to the shelter!
sol5.no_run: Hurry, but don't run. Running burns air.
sol5.half_dose: Water walls here cut the dose in half.
sol5.xrays: Outside, this storm is like 30 chest X-rays.
sol5.stay: We can stay here up to a day.
sol5.sleep_hint: Stay safe. Sleep in HAB 1 when ready.
sol6.quiet: Three quiet sols ahead. Let's skip them!
sol6.dustier: The wings got dustier while we waited.
sol9.plan: Field trip! Find Mont Mercou on the map.
sol9.far: It's 8.8 km away. Close the map.
sol9.drive: Off we go! 8.8 km to Mont Mercou.
sol9.outcrop: This rock wall is 6 meters tall.
sol9.sample: Pick up a pebble for a sample.
sol9.water: Billions of years ago, Gale held a lake.
sol9.home: Great sample! Back in the rover now.
task.s9_plan: Plan the trip to Mont Mercou
sol10.quiet: Two quiet sols ahead. Let's skip them!
task.s12_storm: Find out what happened to the sky
sol12.outside: Commander! Come outside. Look at the sky!
sol12.dark: Look all around. Where did the sun go?
sol12.storm: A dust storm! The dust hides the sun.
sol12.wings: Our solar wings make almost nothing now.
sol12.choose: Power is short. What gets it today?
choice.sol12_power: Storm power for one: heat, air or plants?
sol12.reactor: The reactor keeps working, even in storms.
sol12.planet: Some dust storms cover all of Mars!
task.s13_dust: Brush the dust off your suit
sol13.morning: Morning! Meet me outside. Mind the dust!
sol13.brush: Dust all over you! Brush it off inside.
sol13.toxic: Mars dust is likely toxic to breathe.
sol13.why: So we brush it off before coming in.
sol13.skip: The storm goes on. Let's skip four sols.
sol17.ripe: Our greens are ready! Follow me!
sol17.salad: Our first fresh salad on Mars!
sol18.quiet: Two more dusty sols. Let's skip them!
sol20.plan: Big trip! Find Curiosity on the map.
sol20.far: It's 14.3 km away. Close the map.
sol20.ring: Out there, we can't walk back. Careful!
sol20.board: Climb in! It's a long drive.
sol20.drive: Off we go! 14.3 km to Curiosity.
sol20.touch: Look, but never touch. It's still working!
sol20.archived: Its real spot on sol 5070, archived data.
sol20.lake: Curiosity found Gale once held a lake.
sol20.life: It found what life needs. Not life itself.
sol20.home: Time to go. Back into the rover!
sol21.quiet: Five calm sols of packing. Skip ahead!
sol26.lift: Going home soon! Lift the sample case.
sol26.limit: Our rocket carries only 100 kg of cargo.
sol26.carry: Carry it to the rocket. Walk steady!
sol26.set: Set it down by the rocket.
sol26.suits: Dusty suits stay here. We fly clean.
sol26.skip: Last sols on Mars. Skip to launch day!
sol31.year: Now the trip home takes about a year.
sol31.labs: Labs on Earth will study your rocks!
